name: dyn_quant_pack_4bit_weight
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_dyn_quant_pack_4bit_weight(Tensor weights, Tensor scales_zeros, Tensor? bias, int block_size, int in_features, int out_features) -> Tensor. Tests define the FlagGems portable ABI as a contiguous float32 concatenation of packed uint8 weight bytes, scales, and optional bias; they cover bit-exact nibble byte order, grouped/flat qparams, float16/bfloat16/float32 parameter conversion, noncontiguous inputs, zero output channels, invalid shape/dtype/group contracts, and device mismatch rejection.
